name: yield line theory
definition_zh: 利用板塑性铰线或屈服线机制分析极限承载能力的理论。
usage_overview: 用于楼板极限承载能力的简化分析，通过屈服线将楼板划分为刚性板块，并利用虚功平衡求解；可用于内柱失效情形下钢筋混凝土框架抗连续倒塌能力的评估。

complete_examples.text: The progressive collapse capacity of the structure can be simplified by utilizing yield line theory.
This paper proposes a simplified model for calculation of progressive collapse resistance of framed structure based on the yield line theory.

P042.title: Simplified model for assessing progressive collapse resistance of reinforced concrete frames under an interior column loss
P042.authors: Q Zhang, YG Zhao, K Kolozvari, L Xu
P042.label: Zhang等（2020）

contexts.text: 通过楼板屈服线分割刚性板块，并以虚功平衡求极限承载能力。
